intro.line: lookout: review a diff with the agent.

shots.label: lookout
shots.title: Answer first
shots.line: A fresh reviewer has read the diff. Before its notes, a quiz asks what the code does.

shots.label: The review
shots.title: Or by path
shots.line: The same files as a folder tree.

shots.label: The review
shots.title: Riskiest first
shots.line: Files sit in risk bands, each group saying why. Findings sit on their lines: blocker, major, minor, nit.

shots.label: Back and forth
shots.title: Fixed, then addressed
shots.line: The agent fixes a finding and says what changed. Only you close it.

shots.label: Back and forth
shots.line: On a major it won't fix, the agent replies why and leaves the call to you.

shots.label: Back and forth
shots.line: You dismiss it, on the page.

shots.label: lookout gate
shots.line: No blocker or major left open: the gate passes, and done can follow.
